category_quality_description: Style, lint, duplication and overall code health.
category_dependencies_description: Vulnerabilities, licenses and integrity of dependencies.
category_infrastructure_description: Infrastructure as code and environment configuration.
category_custom_description: Checks defined by the project or by extensions.
capability_lint_description: Static analysis of style and common errors.
capability_secrets_description: Looks for credentials and keys in the code.
capability_secrets-history_description: Looks for credentials and keys in the commits of the Git history, not only in the current tree.
capability_pii_description: Looks for personal data in code and data.
capability_sast_description: Static security analysis of the code.
capability_licenses_description: Licenses of the dependencies and of the distributed code.
capability_tests_description: Runs the project's tests with the language's own test runner and counts the failures.
capability_properties_description: The project's property-based tests (proptest, Hypothesis, fast-check): generated inputs, with the minimal failing input.
capability_architecture_description: Satisfaction of the configured architecture contracts.
capability_api-compatibility_description: Compatibility of API contracts across versions.
capability_typecheck_description: The project's own compiler or type checker: type errors and build failures, located in the code.
capability_iac_description: Misconfigurations in Terraform, Kubernetes and similar.
capability_dataflow_description: Cross-file, interprocedural dataflow analysis: paths from untrusted input to dangerous operations.
capability_ci-cd_description: Misconfigurations and injections in CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions workflows.
capability_api-contract_description: Property-based tests generated from the OpenAPI specification against a configured running target: responses outside the contract, server errors.
capability_supply-chain_description: Provenance and package execution in the lockfiles: install scripts, missing integrity hashes, registries that are not public or not pinned, git sources without a pinned commit and deprecated packages. What needs the network stays unknown, never clean.
template_supply-chain_description: Reads the npm and Python lockfiles offline for provenance and package-execution signals. Comes in by evidence: only when package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, poetry.lock or Pipfile.lock exists at the root of the workspace or of a component (requirements.txt through the lockfiles setting of the instance). Findings of high severity block by default (blockOn); install scripts are reported without blocking (allowInstallScripts). Nothing is installed or downloaded.
capability_dast_description: Security evidence from a configured running target: passive scan by default, active only when explicitly allowed.
template_base_description: The base of any stack: declares the bridge with the quality gate and selects its subchecks. The project's tests and coverage are left for the profile to turn on.
template_dotnet_description: .NET components (csproj, fsproj, vbproj): fits the current chain of the dotnetweb flavor through the bridge, which comes from the base template. The build comes with dotnet-build, the analyzers with dotnet-analyzers, and the tests, coverage (coverlet) and properties (FsCheck) with dotnet-test.
template_github-actions-zizmor_descripti: Audits the GitHub Actions workflows with zizmor. Comes in by evidence: only when .github/workflows has a workflow (.yml or .yaml); without workflows, zizmor is not in the plan.
template_typescript-tsc_description: Type checks TypeScript components with tsc --noEmit and the project's tsconfig.json. Comes in by evidence: only when a tsconfig.json exists at the root of a component or of the workspace. The type errors are located findings; TypeScript is supplied by the project.
template_python-mypy_description: Type checks Python components with mypy and the project's own configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when mypy is configured (mypy.ini, [tool.mypy] in pyproject.toml, [mypy] in setup.cfg or tox.ini). mypy is supplied by the project's environment.
template_python-pyright_description: Type checks Python components with pyright and the project's own configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when pyright is configured (pyrightconfig.json or [tool.pyright] in pyproject.toml). pyright is supplied by the project's environment.
template_go-build_description: Runs go build ./... and go vet ./... in Go components (go.mod), offline. Type and build errors are located findings. The Go toolchain is supplied by you.
template_go-govulncheck_description: Runs govulncheck in Go components (go.mod): known vulnerabilities the code actually reaches. Needs the Go toolchain and the network; govulncheck is supplied by you.
template_rust-cargo-audit_description: Runs cargo-audit in Rust components (Cargo.lock): the RustSec advisories that affect the locked packages. Needs the network; cargo-audit is supplied by you.
template_rust-cargo-test_description: Runs cargo test --offline in Rust components (Cargo.toml): failing tests are findings, line coverage comes from cargo-llvm-cov, proptest property tests get their own rule and metrics, and the integration test targets of tests/ run in a step of their own. The project's tests and build scripts execute.
template_rust-cargo-check_description: Runs cargo check --offline in Rust components (Cargo.toml). Compiler errors are located findings. The Rust toolchain is supplied by you; build scripts and procedural macros of the project run.
template_dotnet-build_description: Runs dotnet build on the project file of C# components. Compiler errors are located findings. The .NET SDK is supplied by you; analyzers and MSBuild targets of the project run.
template_openapi-oasdiff_description: Checks the compatibility of the OpenAPI specification with a reference revision using oasdiff. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has openapi.yaml, openapi.yml or openapi.json. The reference is the baseRef (or baseSpec) of the oasdiff instance in .jgates/tools.yml; until it is set, or when it does not resolve, the stage is blocked, never passed. The tool is supplied by you; jgates doctor says where to get it.
template_go_description: Go components (go.mod): tests, coverage and properties with go test (template go-test); build and go vet come with go-build, lint with go-golangci-lint and vulnerabilities with go-govulncheck.
template_python-import-linter_descriptio: Checks the architecture of Python components with Import Linter: contracts generated from .jgates/architecture.yml or the project's native configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has architecture.yml or a .importlinter, [importlinter] in setup.cfg or [tool.importlinter] in pyproject.toml; without a contract, Import Linter is not in the plan.
template_python-pytest_description: Runs the tests, coverage and Hypothesis property tests with pytest in Python components; the integration tests (tests/integration or the integration marker) run in a step of their own. Comes in by evidence: only when the component (or the workspace) has pytest configuration (pytest.ini, conftest.py, [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml, [pytest] in tox.ini or [tool:pytest] in setup.cfg); pytest is not imposed on every Python repository, and JGates neither installs nor migrates the test framework.
template_python-typescript_description: Repositories with Python and TypeScript components: brings together the python and typescript templates, each tool in the component of its language. The boundary contracts between the components live in architecture.yml (component-boundary rule). Does not repeat the configuration of the two.
template_python_description: Python components: Ruff and the exclusion of virtual environments and caches. Secrets, dependencies, SAST and personal data come from the base template. Import Linter comes in through the python-import-linter template and pytest through python-pytest, each only when the project has its configuration.
template_rust_description: Rust components (Cargo.toml): discovery and explicit configuration. The compiler check (cargo check) comes with rust-cargo-check, clippy with rust-clippy, the tests (cargo test, with cargo-llvm-cov coverage and proptest properties) with rust-cargo-test, and the RustSec advisories with rust-cargo-audit.
template_typescript-dependency-cruiser_d: Checks the architecture of TypeScript and JavaScript components with dependency-cruiser, against the rules in .jgates/architecture.yml. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has architecture.yml; without a contract, dependency-cruiser is not in the plan.
template_typescript-eslint_description: Runs ESLint with the project's configuration in TypeScript and JavaScript components. Comes in by evidence: only when there is an eslint.config (flat config) at the root of a component or of the workspace; without it, ESLint is not in the plan.
template_typescript-vitest_description: Runs the tests, coverage and fast-check property tests with Vitest in TypeScript and JavaScript components; the integration tests (an integration project or *.integration.test.* files) run in a step of their own. Comes in by evidence: only when there is a vitest.config (or a vite.config with the test block) at the root of a component or of the workspace; Vitest is not imposed on every repository, and JGates neither installs nor migrates the test framework.
template_typescript_description: TypeScript and JavaScript components: excludes installed dependencies and build and coverage outputs. Secrets, dependencies and SAST come from the base template. ESLint (typescript-eslint), dependency-cruiser (typescript-dependency-cruiser) and Vitest (typescript-vitest) each come in only when the project has its configuration. Type checking with tsc has no adapter of its own yet.
distribution_problem_distribution_missin: {subject}: the adapter does not say how its tool reaches the customer (shipped, prepared from an authorized source or customer supplied).
distribution_problem_provenance_missing: {subject}: no provenance record ({file}); material without provenance cannot ship.
distribution_problem_provenance_invalid: {subject}: the provenance record {file} is not valid ({detail}).
distribution_problem_license_not_eligibl: {subject}: the license {detail} is not eligible for distribution; it needs a review before it can ship.
distribution_problem_restricted_material: {subject}: {file} carries restricted material ({detail}) and must never ship.
distribution_problem_restricted_source: {subject}: the source {detail} is restricted and must never ship.
distribution_problem_not_shippable: {subject}: the distribution mode is {detail}, not shipped; it cannot be part of the shipped contents.
distribution_problem_review_pending: {subject}: the license review is {detail}, not approved; it stays out of the shipped contents.
distribution_problem_artifact_mismatch: {subject}: the content does not match the pinned identity ({detail}).
distribution_problem_unscannable_file: {subject}: {file} could not be checked ({detail}), so the pack cannot ship.
distribution_problem_acquisition_missing: {subject}: no official acquisition or setup link for the external tool.
distribution_problem_versions_missing: {subject}: the supported tool versions are not declared ({detail}).
template_gitleaks-history_description: Scans the whole Git history for secrets with gitleaks git (redacted report). Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace is a Git repository; runs where secrets-history is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Runs in the security-scanners image that jgates tools prepare pins.
template_trivy-licenses_description: Reads the licenses of the project's dependencies with trivy fs --scanners license. Comes in by evidence: only when a dependency manifest or lockfile exists; runs where licenses is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Runs in the security-scanners image that jgates tools prepare pins.
template_python-mypy-defaults_descriptio: Type checks Python components with mypy even without a mypy configuration: a component without one is checked with mypy's defaults (missing third-party stubs ignored). Comes in by the Python language and runs where typecheck is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). mypy is supplied by the project's environment.
template_python-mutmut_description: Mutation testing of Python components with mutmut 3, in a copy of the component. Comes in by evidence: only when the component has pytest or mutmut configured; runs where mutation is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes. mutmut is the project's own dev dependency and does not run natively on Windows.
template_typescript-stryker_description: Mutation testing of TypeScript and JavaScript components with StrykerJS and the project's Stryker configuration, in a copy of the component. Comes in by evidence: only when a Stryker configuration exists or @stryker-mutator/core is a dependency; runs where mutation is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes.
template_python-codeql_description: Interprocedural dataflow analysis of the Python components with CodeQL (security-extended suite). Comes in by the language and runs where dataflow is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). The CodeQL CLI and its query packs are customer-supplied.
template_typescript-codeql_label: TypeScript and JavaScript with CodeQL dataflow
template_typescript-codeql_description: Interprocedural dataflow analysis of the TypeScript and JavaScript components with CodeQL (security-extended suite). Comes in by the language and runs where dataflow is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). The CodeQL CLI and its query packs are customer-supplied.
template_go-codeql_description: Interprocedural dataflow analysis of the Go components with CodeQL (security-extended suite). Comes in by the language and runs where dataflow is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). The CodeQL CLI and its query packs are customer-supplied.
template_dotnet-codeql_description: Interprocedural dataflow analysis of the C# components with CodeQL (security-extended suite). Comes in by the language and runs where dataflow is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). The CodeQL CLI and its query packs are customer-supplied.
template_python-format_description: Checks the formatting of Python components with ruff format --check and the project's [tool.ruff] settings. The files ruff would reformat are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the Python language and runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
template_typescript-prettier_description: Checks the formatting of TypeScript and JavaScript components with prettier --check and the project's own prettier configuration. The files prettier would reformat are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
template_go-gofmt_description: Checks the formatting of Go components with gofmt -l. The files gofmt would change are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
template_rust-rustfmt_description: Checks the formatting of Rust components with cargo fmt --check and the project's rustfmt.toml. The files rustfmt would change are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
template_dotnet-format_description: Checks the whitespace formatting of C# and Visual Basic components with dotnet format whitespace --verify-no-changes and the project's .editorconfig. The files it would change are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
template_file-size_description: Flags text files over a line limit (5000 lines by default; set maxLines on the instance to change it). Offline and in-process: it reads the workspace, runs nothing and writes nothing. It will replace the file-size subcheck of the quality bridge, which stays in the base template until the bridge is retired, so this template is opt-in.
template_go-golangci-lint_description: Lints Go components with golangci-lint run ./... and the project's .golangci.yml (the default linters without one). Every issue is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where lint is switched on.
template_rust-clippy_description: Lints Rust components with cargo clippy and the project's clippy.toml and [lints] tables. Every compiler and clippy diagnostic is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where lint is switched on.
template_dotnet-analyzers_description: Lints C# and Visual Basic components with dotnet build and the .NET code analyzers at the recommended level, with the severities of the project's .editorconfig. Every diagnostic is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by the language and runs where lint is switched on.
template_shell-shellcheck_description: Lints shell scripts (*.sh, *.bash, *.ksh) with ShellCheck and the project's .shellcheckrc. Every issue is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by evidence: a shell script at the root of the workspace.
template_docker-hadolint_description: Lints Dockerfiles with Hadolint and the project's .hadolint.yaml, without building an image. Every rule that fires is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by evidence: a Dockerfile at the root of the workspace.
template_go-test_description: Runs go test -json in Go components with statement coverage, the rapid and testing/quick property tests, and the integration tests (the integration build tag) in a step of their own. The project's tests execute; the modules come from the dependency volume.
template_dotnet-test_description: Runs dotnet test in .NET components with line coverage from coverlet, the FsCheck property tests, and the integration tests (Category=Integration) in a step of their own. The project's tests and MSBuild targets execute.
template_typescript-jest_description: Runs the project's own Jest with line coverage, the fast-check property tests, and the integration tests (a project named integration or *.integration.test.* files) in a step of their own. Comes in only when the project has a Jest configuration.
template_dotnet-benchmarkdotnet_descript: The BenchmarkDotNet benchmarks of a .NET console project (in process, short job), compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a project referencing BenchmarkDotNet; runs only where performance is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
template_dotnet-efcore_description: dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes (the tools image's dotnet-ef) tells whether the model changed since the last migration. Comes in by evidence: a Migrations/*ModelSnapshot.cs; runs only where migration is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_dotnet-stryker_description: Mutation testing of .NET solutions with the tools image's Stryker.NET, in a copy of the component inside the run folder. Comes in by evidence: a stryker-config file or dotnet-stryker in the local tool manifest; runs only where mutation is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes (timeoutSeconds 900): a run that exceeds it has no score.
template_dotnet-vulnerable_description: The NuGet packages of a .NET component with known vulnerabilities, top-level and transitive, as the .NET SDK reports them from the package sources' vulnerability data (the step has the network). Comes in by evidence: a solution or project file of the component.
template_go-bench_description: The Benchmark functions of a Go module, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a _test.go file at the module root with a Benchmark function; runs only where performance is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
template_python-alembic_description: Alembic upgrades the run's own services database to head and checks that the models need no new migration (alembic check). Comes in by evidence: alembic.ini; runs only where migration is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_python-django-migrations_descri: Django's makemigrations --check --dry-run tells whether the models changed without a migration, with the services database of jgates.yml. Comes in by evidence: manage.py; runs only where migration is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_python-playwright_description: End-to-end tests of Python components with the project's pytest-playwright against its compose services (jgates.yml services:), Chromium from the toolchain volume. Comes in by evidence: pytest-playwright in requirements*.txt or pyproject.toml; runs only where e2e is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Without a services section it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_python-pytest-benchmark_descrip: The project's pytest-benchmark benchmarks, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: pytest-benchmark in requirements*.txt or pyproject.toml; runs only where performance is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
template_rust-criterion_description: The criterion benchmarks of a Rust crate (cargo bench), compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: criterion in Cargo.toml; runs only where performance is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
template_sql-squawk_description: squawk (Apache-2.0, in the tools image) lints the SQL migration files of the workspace for operations that are risky on a live PostgreSQL (locks, required fields without a default, non-concurrent indexes): errors are blocking findings and warnings are reported without blocking. It reads the files only, so it needs no services. Comes in by evidence: SQL files in migrations/ or db/migrations/; runs only where migration is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available).
template_typescript-playwright_label: TypeScript and JavaScript e2e tests (Playwright Test)
template_typescript-playwright_descripti: End-to-end tests of TypeScript and JavaScript components with the project's Playwright Test against its compose services (jgates.yml services:), Chromium from the toolchain volume. Comes in by evidence: a playwright.config.* or @playwright/test in package.json; runs only where e2e is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Without a services section it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_typescript-prisma_description: prisma migrate diff --from-migrations --to-schema --exit-code tells whether the schema changed without a migration, against the services database (the shadow database of prisma.config, a second database of the services). Comes in by evidence: prisma/schema.prisma; runs only where migration is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
template_typescript-vitest-bench_label: TypeScript and JavaScript performance budgets (vitest bench)
template_typescript-vitest-bench_descrip: The project's vitest bench benchmarks, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a bench script running vitest bench in package.json; runs only where performance is switched on (the Strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
adapter_build-check_name: Build and type check (tsc, mypy, pyright, go, cargo, dotnet)
adapter_cargo-test_name: cargo test (Rust tests and proptest properties)
adapter_dotnet-test_name: dotnet test (.NET tests, coverlet coverage and FsCheck properties)
adapter_format-check_name: Format check (ruff, prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, dotnet format)
adapter_go-test_name: go test (Go tests, coverage and rapid/quick properties)
adapter_jest_name: Jest (JavaScript/TypeScript tests, coverage and fast-check properties)
adapter_migration-drift_name: Migration drift (Django, Alembic, Prisma, EF Core) and the SQL migration linter (squawk)
adapter_performance_name: Performance budgets (pytest-benchmark, vitest bench, go test -bench, criterion, BenchmarkDotNet)
